name: Keith McCoy

summary.text: Keith McCoy was ExxonMobil's senior director for federal relations. In May 2021 an investigator for Greenpeace UK's Unearthed, posing as a recruiter, recorded him on a Zoom call discussing the company's lobbying; Channel 4 News aired the footage on June 30, 2021. McCoy said Exxon had joined 'shadow groups' to work against early climate efforts and described the company's public support for a carbon tax as an 'easy talking point' unlikely to pass Congress. ExxonMobil CEO Darren Woods apologised and said the comments did not represent the company's position.

facts.claim: Video released by Greenpeace's Unearthed showed McCoy, Exxon's senior director for federal relations, discussing the company's lobbying strategies to an investigator posing as a head hunter; the Zoom meeting took place in May 2021 and was aired by Channel 4.
facts.quote: An Unearthed investigator posed as a head hunter when speaking with McCoy. The Zoom meeting took place in May and was aired by Channel 4 on a Wednesday.

facts.claim: McCoy said Exxon had joined 'shadow groups' to work against early efforts on climate, adding that there was nothing illegal about it.
facts.quote: McCoy said Exxon had joined some shadow groups to work against some of the early efforts on climate, adding "Yes, that's true." He also said there was nothing illegal about it.
